instruction: In apps/server/src/services/action-proposals.ts, when a host-shell escalation or action approval card settles, its createdAt timestamp is not adjusted cleanly relative to the request turn messages and subsequent wake results: decided cards should sort after existing thread messages at settle time, while cancelled/expired/superseded cards without a user decision should sit right after the last assistant message of that turn before the next user message. Fix settled card timestamp ordering in action-proposals.ts.
